the scheme as on the first working day for the respective time periods. The loads have not been taken into account. Past performance

debt & money market securities such that the

to 4 years. However there can be no assurance 
that the investment objective of the Scheme will 
be achieved. The Scheme does not guarantee / 
indicate any returns.

(Number of Segregated portfolio in the scheme 3)
